description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ruthless Technomancer and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Ruthless Technomancer tokens enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and one of the Ruthless Technomancer tokens and create eight Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
If Dargo costs more than {R} to cast due to commander tax, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B/R}.
Repeat step 5 as necessary.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate the remaining Ruthless Technomancer token by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing two Treasures, returning the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When the nontoken Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 7.
